items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Ida's the youngest lady. Billy came Billy. Then came Edna. Then came me.

ctx.x: Now how much younger was Billy than you?

Well Billy was about, well my mother had us two years apart. So Billy, she was next to Ida. Ida's the youngest lady. Billy came Billy. Then came Edna. Then came me. Then my other two sisters died. The other three sisters died, they were older. Now I know you told me your birthday is in March, is it the 29th of March? Yeah, 29th of March. In what year? Well I'm going to tell you I couldn't get no birthday to you, but anyway they put me 19
or what, but I know I'm not that old. You know, I'm not that old. You know, I'm not that old.
